description: Local live composer dictation with Parakeet, plus voice-note transcription.
configHelp: For live composer dictation, open the Transcriber glance panel in Extensions and explicitly install Parakeet TDT 0.6B v3, the Russian-capable default. It uses a separate pinned CPU runtime and needs a supported 64-bit Python 3.12 installation. Describe the download and current setup status before asking the user to install it. Use Refresh status to see progress or Cancel installation to discard a pending download. The voice-note Whisper model, language hint and remote endpoint are separate settings.
